# Growth fixtures

One file per type -- `training-`, `presentation-`, `goal-` -- in exactly the
shape `docs/hub/growth.md` documents and `{cliPrefix}NewGrowth` writes. They are
what `GET /api/growth` lists in the tests and in the browser smoke run.

The names, dates and content here are placeholders and belong to nobody. A
change to the documented shape changes these files in the same sitting -- that
is the point of them.
